search_nodes.definition: Expanded simulated acquisition nodes on Ray.

measurement_reduction.definition: Measurement reduction at matched baseline reconstruction accuracy.

teacher_plans.definition: MCTS acquisition plans used for policy distillation.

policy_latency.definition: Policy decision time in a live survey loop.

search_latency.definition: Online search time per acquisition step.

reward_speedup.definition: Reward-computation time without reuse divided by time with Redis reuse.

epoch_before.definition: RL epoch duration before the cache improvement.

epoch_after.definition: RL epoch duration after the cache improvement.

run_metadata: Survey and geological-model identifiers, split membership and measurement units.
